patch_description: Preserve original behavior during formation and at low triangle benefit. During recovery, retain the parent's cost-dependent cohorts but sample eligible partners uniformly, reducing concentration on low-numbered actors. Combine cohort reconstruction with the baseline's swap-and-delete mechanism: an accepted rewire replaces one unwanted edge and permits one additional deletion; rejection permits only the standalone deletion. This may accelerate reconstruction, but cohort changes can sacrifice useful ties. Improvement requires full-panel evaluation.
